title: Agents
description: Every AI agent identity registered in this workspace.

createDialog.title: Register a new agent
createDialog.description: Creates the agent record in PENDING_ENROLLMENT status. It won't be able to act until you generate an enrollment token and the agent process completes enrollment out-of-band.
createDialog.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

detail.certUnavailable: Certificate details are issued directly to the agent process during enrollment over mTLS (POST /agents/enroll) and are not retrievable through this console — manar-api exposes no endpoint that returns a live agent's certificate metadata.
detail.notFoundBody: No agent with this ID was found in this workspace's agent list.

enrollment.generateDisabledHint: Only agents pending enrollment can have a token generated.
enrollment.warning: This token is shown only once. Copy it now and hand it to the agent process out-of-band — Manar cannot display it again after you close this dialog.

revoke.dialogDescription: The agent's certificates immediately stop being accepted. This cannot be undone from this console.
